questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。根据上下文“As Jamaica's top goal scorer, she can easily... any boots she wants”，作为牙买加顶尖射手，她经济宽裕，可以“买得起（afford）”任何她想要的球鞋。选项A分享；B买得起，承担得起；C交换；D命令，指挥。故选B。
questions.supplement:
A(share)：语境句：Good friends always share their joys and sorrows. 固定搭配：share with, share out
B(afford)：语境句：I can't afford to buy a new car right now. 固定搭配：can afford to do, afford sth.
C(exchange)：语境句：They exchanged gifts at the Christmas party. 固定搭配：exchange A for B, in exchange for
D(command)：语境句：The officer commanded his men to shoot. 固定搭配：command sb to do, under the command of

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。结合后文“as prizes”，她把这些高质量的二手球鞋作为奖品“赠送（present）”给当地的女子足球比赛。选项A卖；B买；C要求；D颁发，赠送。故选D。
questions.supplement:
A(sells)：语境句：He sells fresh vegetables at the market. 固定搭配：sell out, sell well
B(buys)：语境句：She buys a cup of coffee every morning. 固定搭配：buy in, buy off
C(requires)：语境句：This job requires a high level of concentration. 固定搭配：require sb to do, require doing
D(presents)：语境句：The mayor presented the winner with a gold medal. 固定搭配：present sb with sth, present sth to sb

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。根据语境“in local female football competitions”，在足球比赛中，球鞋被当作“奖品（prizes）”发给女孩们。选项A奖牌；B奖品；C惩罚；D挑战。故选B。
questions.supplement:
A(medals)：语境句：She won two gold medals in the Olympic Games. 固定搭配：gold medal, award a medal
B(prizes)：语境句：He won first prize in the speech contest. 固定搭配：win a prize, first prize
C(punishments)：语境句：Capital punishment has been abolished in many countries. 固定搭配：capital punishment, escape punishment
D(challenges)：语境句：We are ready to face the new challenges ahead. 固定搭配：face a challenge, overcome a challenge

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。“Bunny”并不是她的本名（Khadija Shaw），而是她哥哥给她起的“绰号/小名（nickname）”。选项A绰号；B头衔；C荣誉；D礼物。故选A。
questions.supplement:
A(nickname)：语境句：His friends gave him the nickname 'Speedy'. 固定搭配：go by the nickname of, earn a nickname
B(title)：语境句：The book's title is very catchy. 固定搭配：job title, win the title
C(honor)：语境句：It is a great honor to be invited to speak here. 固定搭配：in honor of, do the honors
D(gift)：语境句：She has a natural gift for music. 固定搭配：birthday gift, have a gift for

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。人们会聚集在一起，对谁会赢街头足球进行“打赌（bet）”。选项A决定；B呼喊/称呼；C打赌；D坚持。bet on 为固定搭配，意为“对……下注/打赌”。
questions.supplement:
A(decided)：语境句：They finally decided to go to Paris for their holiday. 固定搭配：decide to do, decide on
B(called)：语境句：He called her name loudly across the street. 固定搭配：call off, call for
C(bet)：语境句：I bet that our team will win the championship. 固定搭配：bet on sth, make a bet
D(insisted)：语境句：She insisted on paying for the dinner. 固定搭配：insist on doing, insist that

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。Shaw是在“回忆（recalls）”她童年时的情景。选项A回忆；B确认；C承认；D宣布。故选A。
questions.supplement:
A(recalls)：语境句：The old man recalls his youth with a smile. 固定搭配：recall doing sth, beyond recall
B(confirms)：语境句：The test results confirmed the doctor's diagnosis. 固定搭配：confirm one's belief, confirm a reservation
C(admits)：语境句：He reluctantly admitted making a mistake. 固定搭配：admit doing sth, admit to
D(declares)：语境句：The government declared a state of emergency. 固定搭配：declare war, declare one's intention

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。前文提到“I wanted to be a part of that!”，所以她“加入（joined）”了他们一起踢球。选项A拒绝；B赞扬；C加入；D钦佩。故选C。
questions.supplement:
A(rejected)：语境句：The committee rejected his proposal entirely. 固定搭配：reject an offer, reject a plan
B(praised)：语境句：The teacher praised the student for his hard work. 固定搭配：praise sb for sth, sing the praises of
C(joined)：语境句：She joined the tennis club to stay fit. 固定搭配：join in, join up
D(admired)：语境句：I really admired her courage in facing the difficulty. 固定搭配：admire sb for sth, greatly admire

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。后半句提到她父母很看重教育，母亲觉得踢球浪费时间，因此对于她踢球，父母并不“高兴（delighted）”。此处是否定“weren't delighted”。选项A失望的；B烦恼的；C担忧的；D高兴的。故选D。
questions.supplement:
A(disappointed)：语境句：I was highly disappointed with the movie's ending. 固定搭配：be disappointed at/with, disappointed to see
B(annoyed)：语境句：He was annoyed by the constant noise outside. 固定搭配：be annoyed with sb, get annoyed
C(concerned)：语境句：We are deeply concerned about environmental issues. 固定搭配：be concerned about, as far as I am concerned
D(delighted)：语境句：She was delighted to receive the invitation letter. 固定搭配：be delighted to do, be delighted with

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析与固定搭配。母亲尤其认为踢球是“浪费（waste）”时间。a waste of time 是固定搭配。选项A浪费；B事情/物质；C缺乏；D标志。故选A。
questions.supplement:
A(waste)：语境句：Arguing with him is just a waste of time. 固定搭配：a waste of time/money, waste time doing sth
B(matter)：语境句：It's a matter of life and death. 固定搭配：as a matter of fact, no matter what
C(lack)：语境句：The project failed due to a lack of funds. 固定搭配：lack of, for lack of
D(sign)：语境句：A sudden drop in temperature is a sign of winter. 固定搭配：sign of, warning sign

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。根据上下文，Shaw渴望踢球，梦想着在世界上最伟大的足球“锦标赛/赛事（tournament）”中竞争（即世界杯）。选项A典礼；B锦标赛；C体育馆；D练习。故选B。
questions.supplement:
A(ceremony)：语境句：The opening ceremony of the Olympics was spectacular. 固定搭配：wedding ceremony, award ceremony
B(tournament)：语境句：She won the grand slam tennis tournament last year. 固定搭配：tennis tournament, golf tournament
C(gym)：语境句：He goes to the gym every evening to work out. 固定搭配：hit the gym, gym class
D(practice)：语境句：Practice makes perfect. 固定搭配：in practice, out of practice

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。直到14岁时她被“选拔/挑选（selected）”进入牙买加U15国家队。选项A移除；B采纳/收养；C选择/选拔；D欣赏/感激。故选C。
questions.supplement:
A(removed)：语境句：The stain on the shirt was easily removed. 固定搭配：remove from, completely remove
B(adopted)：语境句：The couple adopted an orphan from the local shelter. 固定搭配：adopt a policy, adopt a child
C(selected)：语境句：She was selected to represent her school in the debate. 固定搭配：be selected for, carefully selected
D(appreciated)：语境句：I really appreciated your help when I was in trouble. 固定搭配：highly appreciate, appreciate doing sth

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。父亲“说服（convinced）”了Bunny的母亲，这这对女儿来说将是宝贵的经历。选项A说服；B命令；C询问；D强迫。故选A。
questions.supplement:
A(convinced)：语境句：He finally convinced the jury of his innocence. 固定搭配：convince sb of sth, convince sb to do
B(ordered)：语境句：The general ordered his troops to advance. 固定搭配：in order to, out of order
C(inquired)：语境句：She inquired about the flight schedule at the desk. 固定搭配：inquire about, inquire into
D(forced)：语境句：He was forced to resign due to health problems. 固定搭配：force sb to do, by force

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析与搭配。牙买加国家队击败巴拿马后，“获得了（qualified）”2019女足世界杯的参赛资格。qualify for 为固定搭配，意为“取得……的资格”。
questions.supplement:
A(applied)：语境句：He applied for a scholarship to study abroad. 固定搭配：apply for, apply to
B(qualified)：语境句：She is highly qualified for the teaching position. 固定搭配：qualify for, be qualified to do
C(prepared)：语境句：They are fully prepared for the upcoming exam. 固定搭配：prepare for, be well prepared
D(trained)：语境句：The dogs are specifically trained to detect drugs. 固定搭配：train for, trained professional

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。上文提到了她“dreamed of competing in the sport's greatest...”，此处呼应，她的“梦想（dream）”实现了。选项A信念；B比赛；C成功；D梦想。故选D。
questions.supplement:
A(belief)：语境句：His strong belief in justice guided his actions. 固定搭配：beyond belief, firm belief
B(game)：语境句：Let's play a game of chess. 固定搭配：play a game, video game
C(success)：语境句：Hard work is the key to success. 固定搭配：achieve success, great success
D(dream)：语境句：Her childhood dream finally came true. 固定搭配：realize a dream, dream of

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。当我“回顾（look back on）”过去和现在的处境时，我为自己感到骄傲。选项A尊敬；B期待；C回顾；D当心/寻找。故选C。
questions.supplement:
A(look up to)：语境句：Many young people look up to him as a role model. 固定搭配：look up to sb
B(look forward to)：语境句：I sincerely look forward to hearing from you soon. 固定搭配：look forward to doing sth
C(look back on)：语境句：Looking back on my college years, I have no regrets. 固定搭配：look back on the past
D(look out for)：语境句：Please look out for cars when you cross the street. 固定搭配：look out for sb/sth

section_2_word_form.passage:
African History
Africans are the most diverse people in the world. Perhaps this has a connection with the fact that they are the earliest humans, [56] it has been proved that humans adapt [57] the different environments they find themselves in over time as they migrate.
Before the arrival of the Europeans, Africans had already travelled to other parts of the world in [58] "human migration" waves, and many findings give us an insight into the way of life of much earlier societies.
Ancient Africans were pioneers of early civilization, [59] can be proved with the evidence that early African societies excelled in fields such as engineering, mathematics, writing and navigation.
Some great African civilizations such as the Benin Empire, Ancient Egypt, had a highly [60] society, which was developed, [61] out in trade and grew stronger in culture.
Sadly, Africa's [62], which parallel global developments, are often undercredited.
The abundance of the rich natural resources of Africa soon led to avarice (贪婪) on the part of the Europeans, [63] in a mad scramble for Africa's resources, including its people. Between 11 and 15 million Africans [64] overseas and sold into slavery. Over the years, the wars had been a complex and complicated problem.
Today, most of the conflicts have ceased. The continent is gradually taking [65] place in the committee of nations.

questions.explanation: 本题考查连词。前后句为因果关系：人类经过迁徙随着时间推移会适应环境，【因为】他们是最早的人类（有足够时间迁徙演变），所以非洲人是最多样化的。此处填 as, since 或 because 引导原因状语从句均可。
questions.supplement: 正确形(as/since/because)：语境句：I decided to stay at home as/since/because it was raining heavily. 固定搭配：because of, ever since。其它连词用法：and(并列), but(转折)。

questions.explanation: 本题考查介词。adapt to 是固定搭配，意为“适应……”，此处理解为“适应他们所处的不同环境”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to)：语境句：It took him a while to adapt to the new working environment. 固定搭配：adapt to, contribute to。原词adapt其它变形：adaptation(n.), adaptable(adj.).

questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换。修饰名词短语 "human migration" waves 需要用形容词形式，variety 的形容词形式为 various，意为“各种各样的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(various)：语境句：The school offers a variety of clubs, attracting students with various interests. 固定搭配：various kinds of, for various reasons。原词variety其它变形：vary(v.), variable(adj./n.).

questions.explanation: 本题考查非限制性定语从句。逗号后引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面的整句话“Ancient Africans were pioneers of early civilization”，在从句中作主语，因此填关系代词 which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which)：语境句：He passed the exam, which made his parents very happy. 固定搭配：in which, from which。

questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换。修饰名词 society，且由 highly 修饰，此处需要用过去分词转化为形容词的 organized，意为“高度有组织的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(organized)：语境句：He is a highly organized person who plans everything in advance. 固定搭配：well organized, highly organized。原词organize其它变形：organization(n.), organizer(n.), disorganized(adj.).

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词时态与平行结构。此处 stood out 与前面的 was developed 以及后面的 grew stronger 并列，作定语从句的谓语动词，讲述过去的史实，故用一般过去时 stood。
questions.supplement: 正确形(stood)：语境句：Her bright red dress stood out in the crowd. 固定搭配：stand out, stand for, stand by。原词stand其它变形：standing(n./adj.), outstanding(adj.).

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词单复数。谓语动词为 are，可知主语应为复数名词，contribute 的名词形式为 contribution，故填 contributions，意为“贡献”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(contributions)：语境句：Marie Curie made great contributions to the field of science. 固定搭配：make contributions to, contribute to。原词contribute其它变形：contributor(n.), contributory(adj.).

questions.explanation: 本题考查非谓语动词。欧洲人的贪婪导致了疯狂的资源抢夺。此处作自然而然的结果状语，动词 result 与逻辑主语 avarice/前面的事情呈主动关系，故用现在分词 resulting (in)。
questions.supplement: 正确形(resulting)：语境句：The heavy rain lasted for days, resulting in severe floods. 固定搭配：result in, result from。原词result其它常见用法：as a result, as a result of。

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词时态和语态。主语 Africans 与动词 ship 之间为被动关系（被运送），且讲述的是过去的客观历史事实，故使用一般过去时的被动语态 were shipped。
questions.supplement: 正确形(were shipped)：语境句：The urgent medical supplies were shipped to the disaster area yesterday. 固定搭配：ship out, ship to。原词ship其它变形：shipment(n.), shipping(n.).

questions.explanation: 本题考查代词。指代前文的“The continent（非洲大陆）”，在名词 place 前作定语，表示“它的”，应使用形容词性物主代词 its（逐渐在国际委员会中占据其位置）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(its)：语境句：The company has successfully expanded its business to overseas markets. 固定搭配：its own, on its own, take its place。
